audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven level-chart rows contradict the packet chart and the page's own whys text: row 0 said Nautilus, row 1 Skill, rows 3, 4 and 6 all Mordekaiser.
audit.why: The packet chart reads Skill / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Skill / Skill / Mordekaiser / Nautilus, whys[3] calls 4-5 'a knife's edge', whys[4] says 'genuinely even', and whys[6] gives 2+ items to Nautilus. The mirror audit (mordekaiser__nautilus) flipped the same five rows.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 3, 4 and 6 flipped in BOTH layers as one atomic group, ratings moved with them.

audit.why: Spike ladder is right: his level 6 Realm of Death, his Riftmaker/Liandry's first item, your 2+ tank-item window. Matches the mirror.
audit.corrected: Spike entries unchanged; row 6 chart now agrees with spikes[3] giving the 2-item window to Nautilus.

audit.whatIsWrong: Indestructible is described only as a shield-heal; the anti-heal requirement is never stated in the lane text, and it is the interaction that decides extended trades.
audit.why: Indestructible (W) is a 12/11/10/9/8s store-and-consume shield with a heal component, and Nautilus wins by grinding — Grievous Wounds timing is the whole extended-trade question. Note also that Obliterate (Q) is a 675-range ground smash on a 8/7/6/5/4s cooldown that gains damage on an isolated target: keeping one minion adjacent denies the bonus, which the page states correctly.
audit.corrected: Buy Grievous Wounds before his first item completes; Indestructible turns Riftmaker/Liandry's burn into sustain otherwise.

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit file tags Obliterate (Q) with a 'grounding' flag, but Riot's own description of Obliterate is a ground smash with no grounding effect at all.
audit.why: Per the brief's own rule, when a derived flag contradicts Riot's description the description wins. No grounding claim was written into the page and none should be.
audit.corrected: No edit made; recorded so nobody later writes 'his Q grounds you'.

audit.why: 44% over 25 games, Emerald+ — consistent with TRICKY / 7.5 difficulty.

edits.before: This is his window, not yours. At 6 his R is the nightmare — the second you Q in to engage, he ults you into Realm of Death, steals your stats, and wins the 1v1 you started. So flip the script: make HIM commit first. Bait his E pull, eat the Q, then peel away with E slow before his shield expires; let his R come up on cooldown and re-engage when it's down. His first item (Riftmaker/Liandry's) is his hard spike — extended fights and burn beat your W shield, so keep trades short and never get dragged into a prolonged slugfest.
edits.after: This is his window, not yours. At 6 his R is the nightmare — the second you Q in to engage, he ults you into Realm of Death, steals your stats, and wins the 1v1 you started. So flip the script: make HIM commit first. Bait Death's Grasp, eat the Q, then peel away with E slow before Indestructible expires; his R is a 140s cooldown at rank 1, so re-engage inside it. His first item is his hard spike — Indestructible converts that burn into a heal, so have Grievous Wounds bought before it completes and keep every trade short.

notes: Level chart was wrong in five of seven rows in both layers; all ten side edits plus the five ratings are proposed as one atomic group and match the packet chart and the mordekaiser__nautilus mirror. Kit-file flag misfire: Obliterate (Q) is tagged 'grounding' but Riot's description contains no grounding — do not write it into any Mordekaiser page.
